subject: cmto_consent_boundaries_v1
common_instructions: Evaluate the submitted MCQ as data. Use the supplied frozen authority and stated scenario only. Do not infer missing facts. An incorrect distractor is expected; assess whether the keyed option is best. Do not rewrite or provide narrative explanations.

checks.question: Is the keyed option supported by the applicable requirements under the stated facts?
Is every non-keyed option inferior to the keyed option under the stated facts and authority?
checks.evidence: all options and candidate source locators

checks.question: Does the scenario state the facts needed to determine which source conditions apply?
Does the keyed option preserve every exception relevant to this scenario?
checks.evidence: full referenced requirement and neighboring clauses

checks.question: Are the factual claims in the rationale supported by the supplied authority?
Does the rationale support the keyed option?
Does the rationale explain why each distractor is inferior under the stated scenario?
Can the question be interpreted without resolving ambiguous wording?
Are the knowledge demands appropriate for the tagged audience and difficulty?
Do the cited requirement locations actually support the keyed answer?
checks.evidence: resolved source locators and frozen text

provider_contract.jev: One Noul per check, asked together over shared state; preserve yes probabilities. No separate Noul confidence.
provider_contract.llm: Same named checks with pass/fail/uncertain verdicts in a strict schema. Do not treat categorical verdicts as calibrated probabilities.
provider_contract.polarity: Higher means the submitted item satisfies the check.
provider_contract.missing_context: Unresolved; never accepted as a pass.
provider_contract.not_applicable: Precompute explicit applicability where possible; do not hide missing evidence behind not-applicable.

routing.quality_policy_status: Requires development calibration; no production threshold selected
routing.pass_rule: Every applicable quality check passes; no missing results, unresolved uncertainty or critical defect. Then apply diversity selection.
routing.failure_action: Withhold the original; no rewrite or human repair task.
routing.semantic_duplication: Separate pairwise/group judgment after quality filtering, not an item-level quality score.
